scopeNote: Curated public reference inventory, not exhaustive: 32 named platform/model records and one linked modification. High-level identity, shape, role and evidence only. All gameRole values are fictional proposals, not implemented runtime classes or real-world tactics.

interpretation.family: Broad domain for the atlas; all entries here are aircraft.
interpretation.status: Evidence/document category, not an automatic declaration of fielding. Read fieldUseEvidence and caveats.
interpretation.silhouette: Family-level art cues, not measured engineering drawings; no frame-by-frame motion audit performed.
interpretation.communicationOptions: Communication is independent of airframe and role; not a performance or engineering specification.
interpretation.operators: Representative, qualified context; never an exhaustive operator list or manufacturer endorsement.
interpretation.confidence: Confidence concerns only the narrow attributed claim, not manufacturer effectiveness claims.
